controls.label: Event name, Date, Time, Location, Details
controls.expected: Fields are editable and drive preview/create payload
controls.evidence: Computer Use exposes all five fields as settable and their seeded values drive preview plus POST /v1/meetings. This session's Computer Use tool has no type action, and follow-up macOS key events did not mutate the focused SwiftUI field, so direct typed editing/blank-title validation is not proven.
